# Copilot Instructions

## General Guidelines
- Use tools to gather necessary context before answering questions about the codebase.

## Project-Specific Rules
- Focus on Razor Pages when providing assistance.
- User operates in Visual Studio 2026 and works with a Razor Pages project and two apps named ForestChurches and EmailManagement.
- Integrate ChurchSuite using per-user OAuth PKCE/public-client flow (no static client secret).
